disputes.title: Dispute Resolution Process
disputes.content:
Fair and Fast Resolutions

Our dispute process is designed to be fair to both buyers and sellers. When a case is opened, we freeze the funds in escrow until a resolution is reached.

Timeline

  • Day 0: Case opened by buyer.
  • Day 1-3: Seller/Traveler response period.
  • Day 4: Mnbarh intervention (if not resolved).
  • Day 7: Final decision.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.content:
Your Delivery, Guaranteed

Mnbarh uses a unique traveler-based delivery system alongside traditional shipping methods.

For Travelers

You are responsible for the safe carriage and delivery of the item. Ensure you verify the item content before packing.

For Buyers

Track your delivery status in real-time. Funds are only released when you confirm safe receipt.

fees.title: Fees & Pricing
fees.content:
Simple, Transparent Pricing

We believe in no hidden costs.

  • Buyers: You pay the item price + traveler reward + Mnbarh service fee (5%).
  • Sellers: Standard selling fee of 10% on successful sales.
  • Travelers: You keep 100% of your agreed reward. Mnbarh takes no commission from your earnings.

marketplace-benchmarks.title: Marketplace Benchmarks
marketplace-benchmarks.content:
How top marketplaces earn trust

We study how leading platforms keep buyers and sellers confident.

eBay – Money Back Guarantee

  • Buyer can open a case within 30 days of delivery.
  • Sellers must provide tracking; refunds processed if item is not as described.
  • Escrow-like flow: funds held until issue is resolved.

Amazon – A-to-Z Guarantee

  • Coverage for late delivery or not-as-described items on third-party orders.
  • Buyers file a claim after contacting the seller; Amazon steps in with evidence review.
  • Clear timelines: typically 48 hours for seller response before escalation.

Walmart – Returns & Refunds

  • Most items have a 30–90 day return window with proof of purchase.
  • Free returns at stores or by mail with prepaid labels for eligible items.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method.
What this means for Mnbarh:
  • Upfront timelines for disputes and responses.
  • Proof-of-delivery and tracking required for seller protection.
  • Refunds flow back to the original payment method.

marketplace-shipping-returns.title: Shipping & Returns Benchmarks
marketplace-shipping-returns.content:
Delivery and returns policies that set user expectations

eBay

  • Tracking is mandatory for seller protection.
  • Return windows vary by category; sellers can set policies but must honor them.
  • Return labels often provided; refunds processed after item is received.

Amazon

  • Most items have 30-day returns; some categories longer.
  • Prepaid return labels for many items; drop-off options without packaging.
  • Refunds typically issued within 3–5 business days after receipt scan.

Walmart

  • 30–90 day returns depending on category.
  • In-store returns accepted for online orders with QR code or label.
  • Prepaid mail returns for eligible items; refunds to original payment.
What Mnbarh should mirror:
  • Standardized return windows with category exceptions.
  • Clear requirement for tracking + proof-of-delivery.
  • Refund timing promise (e.g., 3–5 business days after receipt scan).

marketplace-payments-protection.title: Payments & Protection Benchmarks
marketplace-payments-protection.content:
How marketplaces handle money and disputes

eBay

  • Escrow-like funds hold until delivery confirmation.
  • Seller payouts delayed if disputes/claims are open.
  • Chargeback assistance and evidence submission tools.

Amazon

  • Payment holds for new sellers; disbursements on schedule after verification.
  • A-to-Z claims can debit seller if evidence is weak.
  • Built-in messaging and proof uploads for dispute resolution.

Walmart

  • Strict seller performance thresholds; holds or suspensions for high defect rates.
  • Refunds initiated through portal; sellers must respond within set SLAs.
  • Chargeback support with evidence submission.
What Mnbarh should mirror:
  • Funds held until delivery + confirmation.
  • Seller payout delays when disputes are active.
  • Simple evidence upload + clear SLAs for responses.

marketplace-seller-standards.title: Seller Standards Benchmarks
marketplace-seller-standards.content:
Quality bars that keep buyers confident

eBay

  • On-time shipping and tracking upload required.
  • Item-not-as-described rate monitored; thresholds for warnings and limits.
  • Top Rated Seller benefits for low defect rates and fast handling.

Amazon

  • Order defect rate target < 1%.
  • Late shipment rate target < 4%.
  • Valid tracking rate target > 95%.

Walmart

  • On-time delivery and cancellation targets enforced.
  • Listing quality scores; poor scores can hide offers.
  • Performance reviews can trigger temporary suspensions.
What Mnbarh should mirror:
  • Published performance thresholds (defect, late ship, tracking).
  • Badges/rewards for top performers.
  • Progressive actions for breaches (warning → limits → suspension).
